nodes.text:
“Shame on #Media for Fear-Mongering!”

It’s disappointing to see how the media turns every health topic into a source of unnecessary panic just to boost their TRP. Take the recent hype around HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus)—a virus that’s been around since 2001!

nodes.author: saikrishnatwts
nodes.text: Instead of providing balanced, factual information, they sensationalize it as if it’s some new “doomsday virus” brought in by international travelers. This is not a new threat, and cases have been reported regularly for years. people experience symptoms, much like flu or cold.
